title: Meeting George Guesnon at the Entertainers Club
summary: He met George Guesnon at the Entertainers Club after returning from Florida around 1926.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: How about George Gaino? What do you know about George Gaino in the other day?

Oh, I met George Gaino, I'd say, around about after I came back from Florida. That was around about 26. But it was a club called Entertainers Club. All musicians used to meet around there, and we'd always get around there sometime, and sit in the jam, you know, and everything. That's where I met George Gaino. That's when I had moved, and family had moved downtown. Mm-hmm. Yeah.
